title: Median of Two Sorted Arrays
description: Given two sorted arrays nums1 and nums2 of size m and n respectively, return the median of the two sorted arrays. The overall run time complexity should be O(log(min(m, n))). The median is the middle value if the total length is odd, or the average of the two middle values if even.
